releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 2.5.0 (MY ISLAND, PVP, TRADING AND MORE)

The biggest update yet: build your own island, and play with everyone on the public server.

- My Island: your own island to build on with every prop in the game. Any Ferryman sails you there. Press B to build and E to see every prop. Walls are solid, and you can stand on floors, crates and ramps.
- Visit anyone's island with /visit Name, or VISIT ISLAND in Friends.
- Friends (Y): friend requests, JOIN your friends, and private messages with /msg.
- Crews (U): make a crew with a tag over your names, a shared bank, crew chat and rankings.
- Trading: swap cash, materials, pets and axes with other players.
- PvP (V): fight other players who have it on too.
- Emotes (G).
- MY LOOK: make your own character, and buy capes, trails and axe skins.
- Mega pets: 3 of the same pet evolve into a Mega pet with twice the perk and a trick.
- Sly's Armory: 6 legendary axes with new looks and abilities, one for each rebirth.
- Sail back to any island you've been to.
- Server-wide events like double cash and golden rain, when they're on.
